title: Readiness Object — Normalized States, Transition Rules, and Board Visibility
purpose: Normalizes the five readiness classifications (BLOCKED, REMEDIATE, MINOR_FIX, READY, CERTIFIED) as the canonical state model consumed by all boards. Defines transition rules, auto-fail conditions, board visibility, and the relationship between readiness classification and certification state. This is the contract that every board's visibility filter and every session's Go/No-Go decision depends on.

BLOCKED.label: Structurally Impaired — Cannot Enter Pipeline
BLOCKED.description: Item has identity, JSON integrity, or severe structural defects that make it unprocessable. Cannot be certified, cannot be reviewed, cannot be delivered to learners.
triggers: Gate -1 IDENTITY_BLOCKED: QID missing, CorrectChoice missing, pack attribution failed, TemplateFamily unconstructible
Gate 0 JSON_FAIL: file unparseable, DL-017 corruption artifact, QuestionID count mismatch
Gate 0 FIELD_ABSENT: missing required structural fields (Stem, ExplanationCorrect)
Gate 3 HARD_FAIL combined with Gate -1 BLOCKED: identity unresolvable even after attempt
examples: Any item with DL-017 backtick-newline corruption
BLOCKED.actions: Route to EditorialQueue with BLOCK_REASON. Must be manually repaired before re-entering pipeline. Cannot auto-remediate.

REMEDIATE.label: Remediation Required — Structural or Content Defect
REMEDIATE.description: Item has structural or content defects that block certification but are automatically receivable (clear EW[CC], fill empty EW slots, align metadata blocks). Cannot be certified in current state.
triggers: Gate 1 HARD_FAIL: DL-008 present, DL-026 present, DL-016 SEVERE, DL-021 present
Gate 3 HARD_FAIL: compound-key collision, identity reconciliation failure
Gate 4 DL-030 CONFIRMED: wrong answer key (CRITICAL severity)

severityEscalation.CRITICAL: DL-030 CONFIRMED + Certified → P0 immediate governance alert. Learner pool exposure.
severityEscalation.HIGH: DL-008 + Certified → P1 urgent. Learner sees wrong explanation text.

REMEDIATE.actions: Can be remediated by authorized remediation script (batch ≤30 per Rule 5) or editorial session. Post-remediation: re-enter Gate 1 for re-scan.

MINOR_FIX.label: Minor Fixes Recommended — Certifiable with Warnings
MINOR_FIX.description: Item has content-quality issues that degrade educational value but do not affect answer correctness or create learner-safety risk. Can be certified WITH WARNINGS acknowledged by Certification Board.
triggers: Gate 2 SOFT_FAIL: DL-013 boilerplate, DL-010 suspected (unconfirmed)
Gate 2 WARN: EV3 citation missing on Apply+ items
MINOR_FIX.actions: Can be certified WITH WARNINGS. Warnings must be acknowledged by Certification Board. Can be remediated in editorial pass during or after certification.
MINOR_FIX.displayAs: Quality Board: shows with warning badges. Certification Board: shows with DEFERRED flag — certifiable but warnings must be acknowledged.

READY.label: Ready for Certification — All Gates Clean
READY.description: Item has passed all pre-flight gates. Zero HARD_FAIL, zero SOFT_FAIL, zero WARN. Immediately eligible for Quality Board and Certification Board review. This is the ideal pipeline state.
triggers: All gates PASS: Gate -1 PASS (identity valid), Gate 0 PASS (JSON clean), Gate 1 PASS (no structural defects), Gate 2 PASS (no content defects), Gate 3 PASS (identity reconciled), Gate 4 PASS (no calculation errors)
READY.actions: Immediately eligible for CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification by Quality Board + Certification Board adjudication.
READY.displayAs: Quality Board: shows with CERTIFIABLE flag. Certification Board: shows with full detail for adjudication.

CERTIFIED.label: Certified — Learner-Pool Eligible (Not a Readiness State)
CERTIFIED.description: Item is in the active learner delivery pool. CERTIFIED is a question_state value, not a readiness classification. It appears in readiness reports as the inventory count of Certified items; readiness classification is still computed (Certified items can have defects — those that do route to REMEDIATE with escalated severity).
preConditions: Readiness classification must be READY or MINOR_FIX
Quality Board review complete with CERTIFY verdict
CERTIFIED.deltaVariant: CERTIFIED_DELTA: item was previously Certified. Content hash unchanged. Prior certification decision inherited without re-review. Still requires pre-flight gate passage on current pack file state.

transition_rules.description: All valid transitions between readiness states. Transitions are guarded by gate results and (for some) require authorization. Forbidden transitions are listed separately.

transitions.trigger: Gate 1 HARD_FAIL or Gate 3 HARD_FAIL or Gate 4 DL-030 CONFIRMED
Gate 2 SOFT_FAIL or Gate 4 SOFT_FAIL/WARN (excluding DL-030 CONFIRMED)
All gates PASS. Zero defects. Zero warnings.
Defect remediated → re-scan all applicable gates → all PASS
HARD_BLOCK defects cleared → re-scan → only SOFT_BLOCK/WARN remain
Warnings addressed → re-scan Gate 2+4 → all PASS
Quality Board + Certification Board CERTIFY verdict
New scan finds HARD_BLOCK defect on Certified item
transitions.severityEscalation: CRITICAL — learner pool exposure. Auto-triggers governance event.

forbidden_transitions: CERTIFIED → READY (Certified items can only be downgraded to REMEDIATE upon defect discovery, or to In Audit for re-verification)
CERTIFIED → BLOCKED (Certified items were already parseable/identifiable — structural block should not be possible unless file corruption occurs)
BLOCKED → READY (must first become REMEDIATE or MINOR_FIX, then progress)
Any state → CERTIFIED without Quality + Certification Board review
REMEDIATE → CERTIFIED (must first become READY or MINOR_FIX, then pass board review)

auto_fail_conditions.description: Conditions that automatically route an item regardless of other gate results. Checked in priority order — first matching condition wins.

conditions.condition: QID is null, undefined, or empty string
conditions.reason: No identity possible. Item is structurally nonexistent.

conditions.condition: CorrectChoice is null, undefined, empty, or not A-D
conditions.reason: No answer key. Item cannot present a valid question.

conditions.condition: Stem is null, undefined, or empty string
conditions.reason: No question text. Item is unrenderable (DL-034 pattern).

conditions.condition: ExplanationCorrect is null, undefined, or empty string
conditions.reason: No correct-answer explanation. Cannot verify correctness.

conditions.condition: Pack file unparseable via AM-1 and AM-2
conditions.reason: All items in pack blocked until file repaired.
Wrong answer in pool — emergency governance event if Certified.
Learner pool exposure — wrong text in correct-answer slot.

conditions.condition: DL-016 SEVERE on Certified item (EW text topically unrelated)

board_visibility_matrix.description: Which readiness states are visible to which boards. This is the 'Scan Once, Consume Many' enforcement mechanism — defective items are invisible to certification boards.

quality_board.rationale: Quality Board performs 10-dimension CAQS review on structurally-clean items only. Items with HARD_BLOCK defects cannot be quality-reviewed because their content may be incorrect or incomplete.

certification_board.rationale: Certification Board adjudicates CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE decisions on reviewable items. BLOCKED and REMEDIATE items must be resolved before certification can proceed.

governance_board.rationale: Governance Board has full inventory visibility for portfolio safety assessment, learner-pool exposure detection, and session authorization.

registry_board.rationale: Registry Board tracks all items regardless of readiness — identity is assigned at Gate -1, before readiness classification. Registry is the canonical inventory.

throughput_board.rationale: Throughput Board measures BF metrics across the entire item pool. Blocking/remediation rates are key throughput indicators.

board_queue_sorting.description: When a board receives items, they are sorted by priority score. This ensures the most urgent work is processed first.

quality_board_sort.condition: Certified item flagged MINOR_FIX (DL-013 on learner-pool item)
quality_board_sort.label: P0 — current learner-pool quality degradation

quality_board_sort.condition: READY item with highest readiness score
quality_board_sort.label: P1 — ideal certification candidates

certification_board_sort.condition: READY items within the session's assigned wave/domain
certification_board_sort.label: In-scope certification candidates

certification_board_sort.condition: MINOR_FIX items within the session's assigned wave/domain
certification_board_sort.label: Certifiable with warnings acknowledged

certification_board_sort.condition: READY items outside the session's assigned wave
certification_board_sort.label: Deferred

governance_board_sort.condition: Certified items with CRITICAL severity defects (DL-030 CONFIRMED, DL-008 + Certified)
governance_board_sort.label: P0 — immediate learner-safety alert

governance_board_sort.condition: Certified items with HIGH severity defects (DL-026 + Certified)
governance_board_sort.label: P1 — urgent learner-pool quality

governance_board_sort.condition: All other items by readiness score descending
governance_board_sort.label: P2 — portfolio-level monitoring

relationship_to_question_state.description: Readiness classification and question_state are related but distinct. Readiness is computed at scan time from gate results. question_state is a persistent governance field in the pack file / registry. The relationship is: readiness classification determines whether an item CAN be certified; question_state records whether it HAS been certified.

mappings.note: BLOCKED items should never be Certified. If a Certified item becomes BLOCKED (e.g., file corruption discovered), immediate escalation.
REMEDIATE items cannot be Certified. If a Certified item has REMEDIATE-level defects, it is flagged in learner_pool_exposure.
MINOR_FIX items CAN be Certified WITH WARNINGS. Existing Certified items with MINOR_FIX warnings are quality-degraded but not a safety risk.

READY items are certification candidates. They may be Unprocessed (first-time certification) or In Audit (re-certification after remediation). READY items that were previously Certified may skip review via delta (CERTIFIED_DELTA).

session_go_nogo_decision.description: The Governance Board uses the readiness report to make a Go/No-Go decision before any certification work begins. This decision gates the entire session.
session_go_nogo_decision.go_conditions: All of: (a) zero CRITICAL learner-pool exposures unknown to the session plan, (b) pack file hashes match T0 baselines, (c) identity reconciliation complete (Gate 3 PASS for all items), (d) count stability confirmed (2 independent AM-1 parses match).
no_go_triggers: CRITICAL learner-pool exposure not covered by session plan → NO-GO until acknowledged in governance register
Pack file hash mismatch → NO-GO until Sync Anomaly Playbook executed
Identity ambiguity detected (compound-key collision, phantom items) → NO-GO until resolved
Count instability (parse count != expected across 2 independent runs) → NO-GO until reconciled
governance-guard Rule block triggered → NO-GO until block resolved
soft_go_triggers: HIGH learner-pool exposure (DL-026 + Certified) → GO with P1 priority, acknowledge in governance report
EV3 warning rate > 80% → GO with documentation that citation remediation is pending
Gate 2 SOFT_FAIL items → GO with acknowledgment that MINOR_FIX items will carry warnings

drift_detection.description: At session Tmid (~30 minutes), readiness classifications are re-checked against current pack-file state. Any item whose readiness changed since T0 triggers drift investigation.
triggers: Item gained a HARD_BLOCK defect since T0 → possible concurrent-write overwrite (DL-019 pattern)
Item's EW_Pattern changed since T0 → possible unauthorized write or cert wave interference
Item's question_state changed without corresponding REVISION_HISTORY.md entry → UNAUTHORIZED_STATE_CHANGE
Certified item newly flagged with DL-008 → CRITICAL — learner pool exposure introduced mid-session
drift_detection.on_drift: HALT all write agents. Spawn governance agent. Run G1-G5 reconciliation (per Session 31 runbook). Resolve before proceeding.

phase_gate_thresholds.description: At Framework v2 phase authorization gates (S830, S900, S910), readiness metrics are verified against targets. Failure to meet a threshold blocks phase progression.

implementation_reference.artifact_reader: scripts/engine/scan/artifact_reader.js — consumes certification_scan_artifact.json → produces readiness report
